description_target.target_text: Polyomino packing into 3x4: backtracking with rotations + reflections, sorted by size desc then color asc, original orientation first

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define h (rows g))
  (define w (cols g))
  ;; Find connected components (4-conn) using objects function
  (define objs (objects g 0))
	  (define comps
	    (map (lambda (o)
	           (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
	                  (color (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells)))))
	             (list color cells)))
	         objs))
	  (define (normalize cells)
	    (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
	           (mr (first bb))
	           (mc (second bb)))
	      (sort-by (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) mr) (- (second p) mc))) cells)
	               (lambda (p) (+ (* (first p) 100) (second p))))))
  (define (rotate-cw cells)
    (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- 0 (first p)))) cells))
  (define (vflip cells)
    (map (lambda (p) (list (- 0 (first p)) (second p))) cells))
  (define (cells-eq? a b)
    (and (= (length a) (length b))
         (andmap (lambda (i) (= (nth a i) (nth b i)))
                 (range 0 (length a)))))
  (define (add-unique lst item)
    (if (any? (lambda (x) (= x item)) lst)
        lst
        (cons item lst)))
  (define (orientations cells allow-rot allow-refl)
    (define result (list (normalize cells)))
    (if allow-rot
        (reverse (let loop ((cur cells) (i 0) (acc result))
                   (if (>= i 3) acc
                       (let ((next (rotate-cw cur)))
                         (loop next (+ i 1) (add-unique acc (normalize next)))))))
        result))
  (define OUT-H 3)
  (define OUT-W 4)
  ;; Backtracking solver
  (define (try-solve allow-rot allow-refl)
    (define comp-or
      (sort-by
        (map (lambda (c)
               (let* ((color (first c))
                      (cells (second c))
                      (oris (orientations cells allow-rot allow-refl))
                      (oris-with-refl
                        (if allow-refl
                            (let loop ((cur (vflip cells)) (i 0) (acc oris))
                              (if (>= i 4) acc
                                  (loop (rotate-cw cur) (+ i 1) (add-unique acc (normalize cur)))))
                            oris)))
                 (list color oris-with-refl)))
             comps)
        (lambda (c) (+ (* -100 (length (first (second c)))) (first c)))))
    ;; Build empty grid (mutable via reduce)
	    (define (try-place grid idx)
	      (if (>= idx (length comp-or))
	          (if (andmap (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
	                      (grid-positions grid))
	              grid #f)
          (let* ((cur (nth comp-or idx))
                 (color (first cur))
                 (oris (second cur)))
            (let try-oris ((os oris))
              (if (null? os) #f
                  (let* ((shape (first os)))
                    (let try-pos ((dr 0) (dc 0))
                      (cond
                        ((>= dr OUT-H) (try-oris (cdr os)))
                        ((>= dc OUT-W) (try-pos (+ dr 1) 0))
                        (else
                          (let ((can-place
                                  (andmap (lambda (p)
                                            (let ((nr (+ dr (first p)))
                                                  (nc (+ dc (second p))))
	                                              (and (>= nr 0) (< nr OUT-H)
	                                                   (>= nc 0) (< nc OUT-W)
	                                                   (= (at grid nr nc) 0))))
	                                          shape)))
	                            (if can-place
	                                (let* ((new-grid (paint-cells
	                                                  grid
	                                                  (map (lambda (p) (list (+ dr (first p)) (+ dc (second p)))) shape)
	                                                  color))
                                       (result (try-place new-grid (+ idx 1))))
                                  (if result result (try-pos dr (+ dc 1))))
                                (try-pos dr (+ dc 1)))))))))))))
    (try-place (grid-from-fn OUT-H OUT-W (lambda (r c) 0)) 0))
  ;; Try without rotations first, then with
  (let ((r1 (try-solve #f #f)))
    (if r1 r1
        (let ((r2 (try-solve #t #f)))
          (if r2 r2
              (try-solve #t #t)))))))
